turn_text: This is the Politically Speaking Hour on St. Louis on the Air from St. Louis Public Radio. I'm Jason Rosenbaum. Last week, he brought a bit of a shock to the Missouri political world. Notably, it was during the financial crisis, and Luke Demire has always been focused on issues affecting the banking and financial services industry. That crowded primary field also featured brutal attacks and gaps, including two candidates saying their favorite Founding Fathers were Abraham Lincoln and Ronald Reagan. But I digress. While Luke Demire has made no secret of his disgust with GOP infighting over the past year, he told me that the perennial dysfunction isn't the reason he's stepping aside. Luke Demire is 71 and says the time is right for him to legitimately retire and spend time with family. But he did not dispute that things aren't great right now in the nation's capital.
